scope.downstream3dGate: requires explicit owner approval of this 2D packet before any 3D generation

1.8m room width - 0.55m rack depth = 1.25m clear aisle; the public-hall opening approach stays prop-free
5.3m room width - 2.8m table length = 2.5m, leaving 1.25m at both side openings; six chairs flank but do not enter the centered gallery opening approach
the 1.4m exterior entry and 1.2m stair-service opening connect through protected response zones; the empty rack moves to the north wall
3.5m room width - 0.9m cot depth - 0.9m cot depth = 1.7m center aisle; landing-side cots split around the 1.2m opening
both 1.2m landing approaches cross the gallery prop-free; adjacent 1.5m landing/wallwalk links remain outside the room; the central 4.0m x 10.0m gate slot below contains zero props

placementExamples.note: Six approved opening approaches and the center aisle stay prop-free; the compact board fits beside the public entry.

Entry-to-stair response path stays open; the behaviorless empty rack is relocated to the north wall.
Landing-side cots split around the 1.2m opening; mirror for the right barracks and keep its west opening clear.
Both landing links stay clear; adjacent 1.5m stair/wallwalk routes remain external; the mount has no mechanism.

Believable medieval joinery, broad readable silhouettes, neutral studio lighting, full objects uncropped. No room scene, people, doors, text, letters, runes, watermark, toy style, glow edges.

AnotherLife Stonehold fort furnishing sheet, exactly eight isolated objects in a clean 4x2 grid: soldier bunk, locker, empty weapon rack, supply rack, utility cabinet, stackable crate, inspection counter, nonfunctional gate-control mounting plinth with empty sockets. Premium AA dark-fantasy realism; compressed rugged forms, dark timber, basalt bases, soot-aged iron, leather, restrained bronze repairs. Neutral studio, full uncropped objects. No gate mechanism, people, doors, text, runes, watermark, spikes, toy style, or glow.
